original_D10: 2 GiB / 10000 items are initial adjustable proposals, not adopted thresholds; exact BIN-v1 proposal is separate and not substituted as approval.
format_choice: Recommended A: uncompressed deterministic framed BIN-v1 below, no archive dependency. Alternative B ZIP requires separate exact dependency/feature/lock/security envelope and remains unsupported here. New BIN is not legacy SGB1; no signature guessing, silent conversion or renaming.
framing: 8-byte ASCII magic SGABIN1 followed by LF (hex53 47 41 42 49 4e 31 0a); next8bytes unsigned little-endian manifest length M; then exactly M bytes UTF8 JSON manifest; then entry data concatenated in manifest order. Entry offsets relative to first data byte, contiguous from0, no holes/overlaps/trailing bytes. Checked u64 addition before seek/read. No compression/encryption/symlink attributes or filesystem extraction.
manifest: Fixed fields {schema:"SGA-BIN-v1",version:1,source:{project_uuid,document_uuid,format,semantic_profile,semantic_digest,captured_revision},mode:DocumentWithAssets,entries:[{key,kind,size_bytes,digest,offset}],references:[{asset_id,digest,entry_key}],legacy_alias_mapping:[{alias,asset_id,digest}],missing_external:[{id,kind,target_id?}]}. Unknown/duplicate fields rejected. No self digest; source_digest=SHA256 all exact archive bytes, manifest_digest=SHA256 manifest raw bytes; not approval authority.
